title: Harvest Pumpkin Soup
description: This very easy and delicious tasting harvest pumpkin soup will be a great addition to your dinners when you need something to warm you up this fall.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (205 degrees C). Cut pumpkins in half and scoop out seeds. Spray a cookie sheet with non-stick cooking spray. Place pumpkins, flesh side down on the cookie sheet and roast until soft to the touch, about 45 minutes. Remove pumpkins from oven and let cool. Once pumpkins are cool scrape flesh from skins into a food processor. Discard skins.

Add chicken stock to pumpkin and purée. Pour soup into a large saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat. Stir in cream, nutmeg, sage, and salt. Mix well and remove from heat. Serve garnished with a dollop of sour cream.
